name: vLLM KV-cache usage gauge (1.0 = 100%)
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: no bucket family. Renamed from vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc; reading the old name in a dashboard is a silent zero, not an error. A usage ratio is not a headroom signal on its own - see the kv-cache-usage gotcha.
